desc: Ideation: confirm greedy left-to-right matching and answer = max(max rightward displacement, max leftward displacement).
Implement the solution in Python with a `deque` for efficient pop operations.
For each test case, read N, A, B, compute sums, push initial piece positions, then scan B and match.
Track rightward and leftward maximum displacements, output -1 if sums mismatch, else max of the two.
Handle up to 2×10^5 test cases with total N up to 10^6 efficiently using sys.stdin.
Verify edge cases: single piece, all pieces already in place, impossible case from sample.
Test with the provided sample input to confirm output.
